description: Intent i002 (branch hwmon-sysfs-scaled-divisor, snapshot s01 only) complete. Findings written to agent-state/findings/i002.json. Three reported variants of the seed's wrapped-scaled-divisor mechanism, all reached from the hwmon sysfs fan1_target store handler amdgpu_hwmon_set_fan1_target (amdgpu_pm.c:2836-2862, kstrtou32 with no range check -> amdgpu_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm): (1) s01 drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c:1195-1217, high confidence — smu_v11_0_set_fan_speed_rpm checks only 'if (speed == 0)' (line 1207) on the raw input while the divisor at line 1217 is '(8 * speed)' in uint32_t, which wraps to 0 for any speed > UINT_MAX/8 (e.g. 8*0x20000000 == 0 mod 2^32); dispatch rejects only U32_MAX (amdgpu_smu.c:2725); registered for Navi10/Navi14 (navi10_ppt.c:3589) and Sienna Cichlid (sienna_cichlid_ppt.c:3199); divide-by-zero oops in CG_TACH_CTRL TARGET_PERIOD programming. (2) s01 drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega20_thermal.c:189-204, high confidence — vega20_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm checks only '!speed' (line 194), no UINT_MAX/8 bound and no firmware min/max gate, then divides by (8 * speed) at line 204; reached via pp_dpm_set_fan_speed_rpm (amd_powerplay.c:581-594, rejects only U32_MAX) and vega20_hwmgr.c:4433. (3) s01 drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega10_thermal.c:302-320, medium confidence — the seed site itself unfixed in this snapshot (raw speed==0 and ulMin/ulMaxRPM checks at lines 307-310, division at 320), wrap contingent on firmware fan-table limits (u8*100 per processpptables.c:1000-1003). Cross-check evidence inside s01: arcturus_ppt.c:1270 and smu_v13_0.c:1229 both carry the upstream '(!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8)' fix, proving the missing guards are genuine oversights. Classified safe: smu7_thermal.c:280 (ulMaxRPM <= u8*100 = 25500 caps 8*speed), radeon si_dpm.c:6199 / ci_dpm.c:1172 and amd legacy-dpm si_dpm.c:6722 (all inside '#if 0' dead-code blocks), emc2103.c:395 and amc6821.c:479 (clamped/raw divisors), plus ~28 further hwmon fan/pwm store paths (g762, max6620, max31790, max6650, nct6775, nct7904, adm9240, sch5627, w83627ehf, it87, asb100, lm78, lm80, sis5595, via686a, vt8231, w83627hf/w83781d/w83791d/w83792d/w83l786ng, adt7475, adt7470, f71805f, pc87427, corsair-cpro, gpio-fan, f71882fg, dell-smm, aquacomputer) that all zero-check/clamp the divisor, and thermal cur_state_store (state bounded to max_state). Limitations: no runtime reproduction (wrap verified arithmetically against exact u32 types); reachability needs a dGPU with the fan1_target hwmon node, dpm enabled and AMD_FAN_CTRL_MANUAL; non-fan hwmon attributes and thermal governor internals only pattern-scanned, not exhaustively audited.
